title: Mount Wutai
subtitle: A real mountain and a site of Buddhist sacred narratives
timeLabel: Sui–Tang Buddhist geography and later sacred narratives
shortSummary: Mount Wutai combines a real mountain landscape, monastic networks and Buddhist sacred narratives, making the museum's two-layer geography visible.
curatorialDescription: The real map carries only the mountain's geographic referent; relic narratives, visions and Manjusri devotion belong to the sacred or traditional layer.
The record does not project later pilgrimage networks backward into a complete Sui–Tang institutional map.
researchNote: Monasteries, inscriptions, pilgrimage routes and period-specific sources still need to be added at place level.
